name: chalk-talk
description: Say a play out loud (or sketch it) and watch it draw itself in light: X's and O's for youth basketball and flag football coaches, on an aurora-field court.

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.glossary: node scripts/glossary.mjs research/CONCEPTS.md src/sports/basketball-glossary.js && node scripts/glossary.mjs research/FLAG.md src/sports/flag-glossary.js

author: Mutaaf Aziz (https://mutaafaziz.com)
